decisions.statement: A message is printed through the game's chat router rather than a direct chat call.
A tagged message has the tag of the addon that printed the message.
A time prefix is read from the local clock in whole seconds.
Chat history is restored once the player has entered the world.
A restored message keeps the timestamp the message was first stored under.
A caller reaches this library through a game global rather than an import.

definition: an addon library printing tagged chat messages and restoring chat across sessions
